sign.title: Sign document
sign.privacyNote: Your certificate and its password are never stored or logged — they are used only for this signature.

sign.downloadOnlyHint: Downloads a signed copy without modifying the document
sign.timestampHint: Adds an RFC 3161 trusted timestamp (eIDAS advanced signature) proving the signing date. Requires a connection to the timestamp authority.
sign.levelTimestampedHint: Adds an RFC 3161 trusted timestamp (eIDAS) proving the signing date. Requires the timestamp authority.
sign.levelLtvHint: Embeds the certificate chain and revocation proof (OCSP/CRL) in a /DSS; stays verifiable after the certificate expires or is revoked. Implies timestamping.
sign.ltvCaHint: Long-term validation is most useful for a certificate issued by a certificate authority (AIA/CDP); a self-signed certificate only adds the document timestamp.
sign.certifyIntro: Certifying (DocMDP) applies an author signature and declares which later changes are permitted.
sign.docmdpLevel1Hint: Any later change invalidates the certification.
sign.docmdpLevel2Hint: Allows filling form fields and adding signatures.
sign.certifySelfSignedHint: Certification uses a generated self-signed identity. For legal-grade trust, sign with a certificate (.p12) issued by a certificate authority.
sign.verifyIntro: Cryptographically verifies the integrity of every signature in the document.

errors.certificateTooLarge: The certificate exceeds the 1 MB limit.
errors.tsaUnreachable: Timestamp authority unreachable. Try again or sign without a timestamp.
errors.ltvUnreachable: Long-term validation unavailable: the timestamp/revocation infrastructure was unreachable. Try again.
